brief.text: We assemble small espresso grinders. Parts arrive on pallets, get kitted, then burr sub-assembly, final assembly, a run-in test, then pack and ship. About 40 units an hour. The unit is 16 by 12 metres, roller door on the west side, shipping out the east. Water is on the south wall.

requirements.name: Espresso Grinder Workshop
requirements.summary: A small light-manufacturing workshop assembling espresso grinders from kitted parts through burr sub-assembly, final assembly, run-in testing, and packing.
assumptions: Power supply is assumed to be on the north wall since the brief did not specify its location.
Station counts were sized for 40 units/hour at 85% utilization using typical cycle times.
Forklift transport is assumed for moving palletized parts and finished goods in this workshop.
